verified_facts.text: La Dolce Vita Orient Express is a luxury train that journeys through many bespoke itineraries across Italy.
verified_facts.excerpt: the unique luxury train that captures the timeless allure of Italian glamour and design, as it journeys through many bespoke itineraries across Italy

verified_facts.text: The train's aesthetic pays homage to the Italian design legends of the 1960s.
verified_facts.excerpt: pays homage to the iconic Italian design legends of the 1960s, blending elegance with contemporary luxury

verified_facts.text: The train was conceived by Dimorestudio, the architecture and design firm established by Emiliano Salci and Britt Moran.
verified_facts.excerpt: Conceived by the visionary minds at Dimorestudio, the architecture and design firm established by Emiliano Salci and Britt Moran

verified_facts.text: The decor is inspired by the style of Gio Ponti, Nanda Vigo, Gae Aulenti and Osvaldo Borsani.
verified_facts.excerpt: inspired by the style of Giò Ponti, Nanda Vigo, Gae Aulenti and Osvaldo Borsani

verified_facts.text: Guests choose between two cabin categories: Deluxe and Suite Cabins.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose from two categories on board La Dolce Vita Orient Express: Deluxe and Suite Cabins.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe cabins feature cool colors, mirrored back walls and wooden slat ceilings.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Deluxe cabin features cool colors, mirrored back walls and wooden slats ceilings.

verified_facts.text: In Deluxe cabins the sofa unfolds into a double bed at night.
verified_facts.excerpt: The sofa unfolds to a double bed at night, and the ottomans serve as coffee tables and stools.

verified_facts.text: Suite cabins are presented as master bedrooms with a sofa and a table with two armchairs.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Suite cabins are presented as master bedrooms, equipped with a sofa and a table with two armchairs, to encourage conviviality on-board.

verified_facts.text: The La Dolce Vita Suite is arranged in four areas and accommodates up to three guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: This exclusive 30 m² retreat is arranged in four distinct yet perfectly integrated areas, accommodating up to three guests.

verified_facts.text: The La Dolce Vita Suite has a bedroom with an en suite bathtub and a main bathroom with double sinks and polychrome marbles.
verified_facts.excerpt: a bedroom with an en suite bathtub, a main bathroom with double sinks and exquisite polychrome marbles

verified_facts.text: The La Dolce Vita Suite's floors alternate wool carpet with Venetian terrazzo.
verified_facts.excerpt: The floors alternate the softness of wool carpet with the preciousness of Venetian terrazzo

verified_facts.text: The La Dolce Vita Suite displays artworks on silk crepe created by artist Marta Benet.
verified_facts.excerpt: artworks on silk crêpe specially created by artist Marta Benet evoke abstract Italian landscapes

verified_facts.text: La Dolce Vita Suite guests have a personal Suite Conductor during the stay on board.
verified_facts.excerpt: During the stay on board, guests will have a personal Suite Conductor, an exclusive host who coordinates and customizes every aspect of the experience

verified_facts.text: La Dolce Vita Suite guests have a private luxury vehicle for transfers to and from the departure and arrival stations.
verified_facts.excerpt: For transfers to and from the departure and arrival stations, a private luxury vehicle is available

verified_facts.text: A pianist is always on board and performs live during aperitivo and through the evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: A pianist is always on board and performs live during aperitivo and throughout the evening atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: After dinner, guests can enjoy a live show of about an hour and a half.
verified_facts.excerpt: After dinner, guests are invited to enjoy a live show lasting approximately one hour and a half.

verified_facts.text: The reservation includes the transfer to the train station, accommodation, table d'hote meals, beverages, on-board entertainment and applicable taxes.
verified_facts.excerpt: reservation includes the **transfer** to the train station, **accommodation**, the **table d’hôte, beverages**

verified_facts.text: Optional offboard experiences are available at an additional cost.
verified_facts.excerpt: Optional offboard experiences are available at an additional cost.

verified_facts.text: Children under 12 are not permitted on board.
verified_facts.excerpt: Persons **under the age of twelve**(12) at the time of Transport are not permitted on board under any circumstances.

verified_facts.text: The departure lounge has changing rooms with showers and an Italian cafe area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Refresh yourself in our changing rooms with showers before relaxing in the Italian café area.

verified_facts.text: Some journeys travel one way between Rome and Istanbul.
verified_facts.excerpt: Travel one way between Rome and Istanbul and immerse yourself in the enchanting magic of the East.

verified_facts.text: A dedicated Suite is designed for guests with reduced mobility and is located close to the common areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: A dedicated Suite has been specifically designed to accommodate guests with reduced mobility. It is located close to the common areas to facilitate access.

verified_facts.text: There are no laundry services or irons on board.
verified_facts.excerpt: there are **no laundry services or irons** on board.

verified_facts.text: The whole train is available for full private charter, subject to availability.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Dolce Vita Orient Express is available for full private charter, subject to availability and operational feasibility.

verified_facts.text: All Deluxe Cabins and Suites have a private bathroom with shower, toilet and vanity area.
verified_facts.excerpt: All Deluxe Cabins and Suites feature a private bathroom with shower, toilet and vanity area.

verified_facts.text: At each train stop, a transfer is provided from the arrival station to the city centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: At each train stop, we will provide a **transfer from the arrival station to the city centre**.
